method: Dedicated worker per library; ten warmups; 100 single-input samples; fixed repeated four-input batches. Timings cover public parse calls, including gpu-time date resolution and recurrence previews, excluding worker messaging and DOM. No complete parse-result cache is used. Initialization includes local development module loading. Different output contracts make this an experimental workload comparison, not an interchangeable-feature ranking.
